steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In October 2026, a guest on Equity Mates highlighted a 25-year record of market share gains and double-digit returns on invested capital, usually around 30 to 35 percent, framing JB Hi-Fi as a strong operator positioned for a growing tech market despite recent sales pressure.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In August 2022, Equity Mates reported JB Hi-Fi lifted its dividend 43 percent alongside revenue of $9.3 billion and profit of roughly half a billion dollars, indicating a willingness to return cash to shareholders.
